name: Being Clean
overview: Scripture reveals that being clean is both a spiritual and moral condition that God desires for His people. Through the cleansing power of God's word, believers are purified, as Jesus affirms that we are made clean by His teachings. This inner purity is a heartfelt plea in Psalms, where the psalmist asks God to create a clean heart and renew a steadfast spirit. God commands His people to wash themselves and turn away from evil, emphasizing the necessity of repentance and holiness. Ultimately, God's cleansing is demonstrated supremely in the gift of His Son, through whom believers receive eternal life and are declared clean and set apart.
